Log my Care is an intuitive care management platform that helps care providers deliver more Person-centered care.

If you’d like a demo, click here [https://www.logmycare.co.uk/book-demo].

The Carer App is where care teams work and deliver care to their service users.

The Carer App works alongside the Care Office to form our platform.

To get started, you’ll need to sign up here first: logmycare.co.uk/sign-up

Once set up, within the Carer App, you’ll be able to:

- Log the care you’re delivering, including food, clinical care, activities, incidents, and handovers. You’ll also be able to upload photos and short videos.
- Securely access your service users' care documents.
- Review and action your daily to-dos from your care management team.
- Access and review care and support plans that your Care Manager has already built within our platform.
- Unlock access to our specialist features, such as PBS, goal tracking, and progress tracking.
- Our Rostering add-on lets carers view their upcoming schedules and any planned absences, including the ability to clock in and out with a single tap.

Learn more at Logmycare.co.uk

Altra Family is a revolutionary app designed to bridge the gap between nursing homes, residents, and their families. It helps to connect family members with caretakers and administrators in nursing homes, while providing transparency and support to all involved.

Altra Family provides a way for families to be more involved in the daily lives of their loved ones. With the app, family members can access personalized news about their loved one’s experience, including pictures, activity updates, personal messages. They can also easily leave messages for their family member or booking personalized services, ask questions and get answers from the facility team and more.

results.description:
You didn't plan to become a carer. You just loved someone.

Now you're the one holding the appointment letter, the medication list, and the group chat nobody answers.

You're the one calling to check whether anyone visited. The one who knows what three different people promised to do this week.

There are days it feels like too much. Days when you wish someone else would step up, even for an hour. That feeling is not a failure. It's what happens when one person carries more than one person should.

The hardest part is not the doing. It is the knowing: being the one who always holds the full picture, because it lives only in your head.

KinCarer puts that picture somewhere the whole care circle can see it.

One shared schedule for tasks, visits and appointments. Check-ins so everyone knows someone arrived, without anyone having to phone. A chat beside the schedule, where any message can become a task in two taps. Routines and medication notes, so whoever visits next knows what's needed. Care Files for the documents that matter, somewhere the whole circle can find them.

When the picture is shared, the load is shared. Not just the doing, but the knowing.

WHO KINCARER IS FOR
Families looking after an elderly parent.
Brothers and sisters sharing the care from different towns.
Partners caring for someone with dementia or a long-term condition.
Families caring alongside paid carers or a care agency.
Anyone who has become the one who holds the full picture.

SHARED SCHEDULE
Add tasks, visits, appointments and reminders so everyone in the care circle can see what needs doing, who is doing it, and what has already happened.

CHECK-INS
Let the care circle know when someone has arrived at the care location. Turn on automatic check-ins and it takes one tap when a phone notices the arrival. KinCarer does not show live movement.

CIRCLE CHAT
Family and carers talk beside the schedule, not in another app. Anything decided in the chat can become a task or appointment in two taps, so nothing important gets buried.

ROUTINES AND MEDICATION
Keep daily routines, medication notes and care preferences together, so the next person helping knows what's needed.

HANDOVER NOTES
Leave an update after visits, appointments or changes so everyone stays in the loop without repeating the same messages.

CARE FILES
Store GP letters, care plans, photos and other documents in one place, so your care circle can find what matters when they need it.

CLARA AI ASSISTANT
Ask Clara what happened today, who checked in, or what is still waiting for someone. Clara answers only from what your circle has written down. Clara is optional and does not give medical advice.

CARE CIRCLE
Invite family members, friends, neighbours or paid carers. Roles and permissions help make sure people see the right information for how they are helping.

ONE SUBSCRIPTION FOR THE WHOLE CIRCLE
Family+ is one plan for the whole care circle, paid monthly or yearly, with 14 days free on the yearly plan. One subscription covers everyone: there is no member limit, and everyone you invite joins free. If Family+ ends, the circle becomes read-only until someone renews. Nothing is deleted.

KinCarer does not replace the love, judgement or care you already give. It helps you organise it, share it and feel less alone carrying it.

Download KinCarer and share the load.

Important: KinCarer is a family care coordination and planning app. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, emergency response, safeguarding services or professional care services. Clara AI provides organisational support only and should not replace advice from qualified professionals.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled in your App Store settings.

Privacy Policy: https://kincarer.com/privacy

If elderly care matters to you, open the Keys to Care app.  As a care worker, relative or carer at home you will find inspirational, practical guidance to help you improve the health and wellbeing of those you look after. On topics from Continence Care to Emergencies it gives reminders of what to think about, ask and do. This friendly app also gives news and information, plus links and opportunities to share your own experience.

The Keys to Care
•	The Care Plan
•	Care at Night
•	Continence Care
•	Daily Life
•	Dementia
•	Eating & Drinking
•	Emergencies
•	End of Life Care
•	Family & Friends
•	Listening & Talking
•	Mouth & Teeth Care
•	Privacy & Choice

The Keynotes
Each Key to Care gives a link to its Keynote with more details, examples of good practice and ideas you could use, plus a note of legal requirements and recent research.

Produced by The Relatives & Residents Association (R&RA) with specialist advice and the help of people who live and work in residential care homes, the Keys to Care app also features:
•	News and comment  - finance, regulation, issues of concern
•	Twitter – R&RA mediated
•	More – useful links

R&RA welcomes users’ views. info@relres.org

Nursebuddy app is mobile interface for carers to access Nursebuddy services.

Care workers and nurses can capture and report important observations in just a few clicks giving each stakeholder involved the ability to follow the status of the person being taken care of.

Nursebuddy
* Introducing next generation Home Care
* Connect sensors easily. Attach 3rd party applications. Open API for developers.
* Real time information about current and forthcoming tasks


Note: Application uses location services for real time task updates and automated reporting. Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life. Background positioning will shut down when you log out.

results.description:
It's evening. The dishes are done, the house is quiet — but your mind is still going. Did Mom take her pills? Did anyone confirm tomorrow's appointment?

Evening In gives your family one calm place for all of it: a shared, private care record where you, your siblings, and a paid aide can track medications, confirm each dose, and coordinate appointments.

And your parent never has to download anything or learn an app.

WHY FAMILIES CHOOSE EVENING IN

Peace of mind every evening. See at a glance that today's medications were given — and exactly who gave them.

Everyone on the same page. One shared care log the whole family sees in real time. No more group texts that scroll forever.

Mom never has to learn an app. You run everything from your own phone. No second login, nothing for her to set up.

Doctor-ready in one tap. Generate a clean medication list and emergency summary for any appointment or ER visit.

The basics stay free, forever. Your medication list, dose logging, and printable list are free. No ads. No pharmacy funnel.

BUILT FOR REAL FAMILIES

Coordinate across siblings — see who's covering which appointment. Invite a paid aide the same way. Reminders that actually fire, not silent failures. Your family's information stays in your control, processed on your device through iCloud.

EVENING IN PLUS — OPTIONAL UPGRADE

Plus adds capacity and convenience: care for up to four loved ones, open your circle beyond two helpers, smart scan, and a saved-provider directory. Monthly $4.99 · Yearly $39.99 · Lifetime $69.99, a one-time purchase that does not renew.

Subscription payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. A subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours of the end of that period. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.evening-in.com/privacy

Evening In is a tracking and coordination tool, not a medical device. It does not provide medical advice or calculate dosages — always consult your parent's doctor before making medical decisions.

Manage care plans, communicate with family and members of the care team, and access other useful features anytime from the palm of your hand. Save time while getting the support and peace of mind you need through every stage of the elder caregiving journey.

App Highlights: 
• Manage appointments, medicine dosages, exercise regimens, and other caregiving tasks  
• Confidentially document, store, and access health history and care plan
